thread:
leah_partnerships: FYI — OrionCloud sent a shortfall notice: 24 pods bumped to a later manifest. This will affect the Dedicated EU go-live we planned for next Tue.

jason_ops: Oof. ETA for the delayed pods?

leah_partnerships: Partner updated ETA to 2026-04-03 for the 24 units. Here's the manifest snippet they pasted: 
```
SKU: ORC-POD-32GB x24
ETA: 2026-04-03
Status: partial-ship
ManifestHash: a7f3d2...
```

sara_prod: Is this only EU or does it hit US reserved capacity too?

leah_partnerships: Only EU batch is affected for now. We still have our marketplace reservations tied to the EU commit window, though.

tony_fw: Do we have spare hardware in staging we can hot-swap? I think staging pool shows 8 available pods.

jason_ops: 8 isn't enough to cover the gap. Short-term ideas: (A) expedite freight for the 24 (air) (B) borrow capacity from ByteCloud partner temporarily (C) delay the customer-facing announcement by one week. Need decision + cost impact.

maria_sales: We should avoid delaying the announcement if possible — customer pilot is lined up. But if borrowing capacity increases latency, that's also bad.

leah_partnerships: TL;DR: need procurement to ask Orion for a freight quote + manifest reconciliation, and simultaneously ping ByteCloud to see if they can lend ~16 pods for 7 days. I'll draft comms.

jason_ops: I'll open a procurement ticket and ping ByteCloud on their partner channel now. If ByteCloud can't help, we'll push for expedited freight.

sara_prod: Agreed — ByteCloud first. If we expedite, we need to confirm whether the extra freight cost is billable to the customer or absorbed. @maria_sales , what's our default?

maria_sales: Default is to propose a change order for customer billing, but we can eat cost for strategic pilots. Need approval from Revenue Ops for >$Xk.

leah_partnerships: Draft to Orion below — @jason_ops please send from procurement account so it looks formal: 
```
Hi Kevin,

We observed 24 units moved to a later manifest which impacts our Dedicated EU commit and the joint go-live scheduled 2026-04-01. Please confirm: 
1) Can you provide corrected ASN(s) and the manifest reconciliation (file + hash)?
2) Can the 24 units be put on an expedited partial release (air freight)? If so, please share ETA delta and freight cost.
3) Any chance to split the shipment so we get an initial 16 units earlier?

This info is time-sensitive as it affects our marketplace reservations and our public announcement.

Thanks,
Leah
```

orioncloud-bot: Manifest update received 1718723440 — status changed to partial-ship. Tracking will be attached when carrier confirms. :ship: :eyes:

jason_ops: Nice. ByteCloud pinged back saying they can spare up to 12 pods for a 10-day window but need a signed temporary amendment. I'll draft a short MOU and estimate network routing changes.

maria_sales: If ByteCloud can do 12, and we expedite 12 from Orion, that nets 24 — perfect. Approve moving forward with a combined plan. I'll flag the possible change-order for customer.

leah_partnerships: Ok plan: 1) Jason: pursue ByteCloud MOU + routing adjustments 2) Procurement: request expedited freight quote for remaining pods 3) I'll prepare the customer/marketing comms draft in case we need to slip the announcement by 72h.

jason_ops: Assigning ticket INF-4712 to track ByteCloud loan + routing. Estimated ops effort: 2 engineers, 4 hours, rollout window overnight.

leah_partnerships: Scheduling a quick 15m sync in 15 to lock on owners. If anyone can't make it ping here.

maria_sales: I'll join. Also looping PM to keep pilot customer informed.

jason_ops: Will update ticket with ByteCloud MOU draft and link to manifest reconciliation when Orion replies.

leah_partnerships: thanks all — will update thread after the sync. :white_check_mark:
